home.metaDescription: Trusted sitters with real business tools, plus a network of neighborhood vets, pet shops, and groomers. Launching in Gijón.
home.heroPetLine1: Sometimes my humans have to leave.
home.heroPetLine2: Someone has to take care of me.
home.heroPitch: We're recruiting the first pet sitters in Gijón. Local network, real tools, discounts at the neighborhood's vets and shops.
home.heroCta: I want to sit pets in Gijón
home.heroProof: Launching in Gijón · Local pet-care network with neighborhood businesses
home.why1Title: You set the price, you set the schedule
home.why1Desc: Connect with pet owners in the neighborhood. Choose when you work, what you charge, and which pets you sit.
home.why2Desc: Calendar, client records, invoices, and a tax summary for your accountant. What a booking-only platform doesn't give you.
home.why3Title: A local network with discounts for your clients
home.why3Desc: We work with Gijón's vets, pet shops, and groomers. Your clients get real discounts, and you're the one presenting them.
home.partnersTitle: The neighborhood businesses joining the network.
home.partnersLead: Gijón vets, pet shops, and groomers offering discounts to our sitters' clients.
home.partnersCta: Do you have a business in Gijón? Join the network
home.honestBody: We're a local team, not a global platform translated into Spanish. If you join as a sitter now, you help build the network with us from day one.
home.ownerWaitlistTitle: When my humans aren't home, I need someone.
home.ownerWaitlistDesc: Sign up and we'll let you know when verified sitters are available near you.
home.ownerThanks: Thanks. We'll let you know as soon as there are sitters near you.
home.guaranteeDesc: If something doesn't go right, we help you sort it out. All sitters are verified and every visit is protected.
